decisions.reason: It is close to the core range and was given its own page in both years, which signals visible commitment and makes management reluctant to reverse course in a growing market.
Although presented less prominently than A, it has stayed on the site for two years and fits the firm’s established facial-care business, so sunk effort and strategic fit favor continuation.

As a newer and less publicly emphasized launch it is easier to cut than A or B, but because it is still close to the core offer and the firm can attribute any early weakness to launch-phase factors, management is more likely to retain it for now.
